_comment: Shared by packages/core/src/task/write-backstop.test.ts and plugins/claude/hooks/check-stage-guard.test.mjs. commandAllowed is a declared TWIN across those two files (core needs it to admit a plan-discovered check command; the hook needs it to guard a stage agent's bash), and a twin with two private vector tables drifts silently. Add a case here, not in one suite.
denied: npm test && git push origin main
_not_denied_comment: `cd /etc; cat shadow` is ALLOWED and belongs in neither list: `cat *` already reads any path, so the allowlist's scope is 'runs nothing that writes', not 'stays in the work tree'. A discovered check inherits exactly that boundary — no more, no less.
_prefix_comment: config `bashAllowlistPrefix` — a command-rewriting proxy puts its own name in front of what the stage asked for. Both suites run these against the globs above re-expressed behind each prefix, which is what the hosts stamp/append. The point of the denied list: the prefix re-expresses the boundary, it does not dissolve it, and a classifier that anchors on the bare tool name must still see through one hop.
prefixDenied: rtk npm test && rtk git push origin main
